title: Alignment Red Team - Research Engineer/Research Scientist
description:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is 11th October 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.  

Team Description 

Risks from misaligned AI systems are growing increasingly important as AI systems become more capable, autonomous, and integrated into society. Understanding these risks and stress-testing mitigations is crucial to ensuring advanced AI systems are developed and deployed safely and beneficially in the future. 

The Alignment Red Team is a specialised subteam within AISI's wider Red Team focused on detecting and evaluating misalignment in frontier AI systems. We perform novel research to develop techniques for finding misalignment, and pre- and post-deployment evaluations of frontier AI systems to understand loss-of-control risks associated with models, such as deceptive alignment, research sabotage, and reward-seeking. We share our findings with frontier AI companies and the UK and allied governments, to inform their respective deployments, research, and policy-making. We also work directly with safety teams at frontier labs, sharing our evaluation findings to help improve their model alignment training and monitoring methodology. 

We have conducted pre-deployment testing with multiple frontier AI companies for propensities related to research sabotage , cheating and unsanctioned cyber-attacks . We previously found that Claude models would sometimes refuse to help with benign AI safety research, an issue which Anthropic then evaluated for and fixed in their next model release . 

About the Role 

We're seeking Research Engineers and Research Scientists to join our Alignment Red T eam . We are open to hires at junior, senior, staff and principal research scientist / engineer levels. 

What You'll Be Doing 

- Researching methods to automatically search for misalignment in frontier models, including misalignment related to loss-of-control risks such as research sabotage and reward-seeking . 

- Building and running alignment evaluations relevant for loss-of-control risks that current benchmarks don’t capture . 

- Running pre-deployment evaluations to test the alignment of AI systems , and analysing and reporting results to frontier AI companies and UK and allied governments. 

- Contribut ing to public-facing research publications (like our published alignment evaluation case study) and technical reports that advance the field's understanding of mis alignment risks and alignment evaluation methodology . 

- Designing and building software and tooling, including open-source software, for better alignment evaluations, improving efficiency, realism, and usability . 

The work could also involve 

- Conducting threat modelling, analysis, and conceptual thinking to understand crucial model behaviours that could lead to loss of control (e.g. AI research assistants at frontier labs), translating abstract risk concepts into concrete, testable hypotheses. 

- Performing alignment incident investigations to understand after the fact what drove certain kinds of misaligned behaviour in frontier models. 

- Mentoring and advising external collaborators and researchers to do work relevant to the team ’ s goals and alignment testing more broadly. 

Who we're looking for 

Essential requirements 

- Ability to work autonomously on complex research projects involving substantial engineering . Have completed at least one significant research project in AI safety, security or alignment involving engineering, experiment design and analysis on frontier LLMs. 

- Strong software engineering and ML experience writing complex projects involving language models and ML, beyond just research code . 1+ years professional experience programming in Python for ML or SWE work. 

- Experience writing clean, documented research code for machine learning experiments, including experience with ML frameworks like PyTorch or evaluation frameworks like Inspect . 

- Proven ability in a team environment – flexible, adaptive to needs, and willing to contribute wherever necessary . 

- Impact-driven mindset, motivated by doing the most important work rather than what's superficially impressive . 

- High velocity and high-quality bar for outputs . 

Highly Desirable 

We don't expect candidates to have all of these – they're additional signals that help us identify exceptional fits for specific aspects of the role. 

- Ability to make high-quality decisions by identifying risks and testing assumptions, demonstrated through strong prioritisation of research projects using clear, systematic criteria such as potential impact, feasibility, and the relative novelty of the research area.

- Familiarity with alignment literature, current methods for post-training and aligning LLMs, loss-of-control risks and threat models, and the current state of the field . 

- High-quality research papers (first author at top ML venues such as NeurIPS , ICLR or ICML ), particularly in relevant areas (such as AI safety, alignment, control, adversarial ML or evaluations) . 

- Professional e xperience working on alignment or evaluations , especially at frontier labs or other frontier 3 rd party evaluators. 

- Strong open-source software projects , particularly related to LLMs. 

- Proficient usage of LLM coding tools and agents . 

Selection process 

The interview process may vary from candidate to  candidate,  however, you should expect a typical process to include some technical  proficiency  tests, discussions with a cross-section of our team at AISI (including non-technical staff) and conversations with your team lead. The process will culminate in a conversation with members of the senior leadership team here at AISI.      

Candidates should expect to go through   some or  all of  the following stages once an application has been  submitted :    

- Initial assessment 

- Initial screening call 

- Technical assessment 

- Research interview 

- Behavioural interview 

- Final interview with members of the senior leadership team 

What We Offer 

Impact you couldn't have anywhere else 

- Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. 

- Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. 

- Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. 

- Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. 

Resources & access 

- Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. 

- Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. 

- Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. 

Growth & autonomy 

- If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 

- 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. 

- Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. 

- Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. 

Life & family* 

- Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. 

- Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. 

- At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. 

- Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). 

- On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension. 

- Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. 

*These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. 

Salary 

Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary. 

This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures. 

The full range of salaries are available below: 

- Level 3: £65,000–£75,000 (Base £39,850 + Technical Allowance £25,150–£35,150)

- Level 7: £145,000 (Base £74,605 + Technical Allowance £70,395)

Additional Information

Use of AI in Applications 

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use. 

Internal Fraud Database 

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented. For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register. 

Security 

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance . Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

At Optimove, we believe people are capable of more than a single job description. You’re not hired just to fill a position- you’re empowered to shape it, grow it, and make it your own.
We call this being Positionless.
And Positionless isn’t just our culture. It’s our product.
Optimove is the creator of Positionless Marketing, an AI-powered platform that gives every marketer the power to analyze, create, launch, and optimize independently. The result is faster execution, deeper personalization, and 88% greater campaign efficiency.
Recognized as a Visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant, we partner with leading brands like Sephora, Staples, and Entain. Today, more than 500 Optimovers across NYC, London, Tel Aviv, Scotland, Brazil, Estonia, and beyond are building the future of marketing together, in an environment that actively encourages ownership and growth, with two out of every three managers promoted from within.
If you’re looking for a place where you can do more, be more, come grow with us.

About the Role 

As a Customer Data Engineer, you will be a part of a strong energetic and fast-growing global team. You will be an integral part of clients' ongoing data requests and projects. You will be working closely with internal CSM teams as well as interacting directly with clients’ data teams across different business verticals. Your core responsibilities will involve playing an active role in collaborating with internal teams to construct tailored data transformations and manipulations while working with top-notch technology (Cloud tech etc.) The ideal candidate is an SQL whiz with a strong work ethic, robust analytical and technical capabilities, and highly effective time management skills. We are looking for a master multi-tasker who thrives in challenging, fast-paced environments, with agility and ease.

The Customer Data Engineer is a position that brings with it an excellent opportunity to learn and grow within a rapidly expanding company on the cutting edge of Martech.

Responsibilities: 

- Develop and support a wide range of data transformations and migrations

- Construct custom ETL processes: Design and implementation of data pipelines and data marts, access versatile data sources, and apply data quality measures

- Investigate data mismatches and apply solutions

- Work side by side and support the Customer Success teams in order to meet customer business needs.

- Interact with clients to understand business needs and collaborate on project scopes, planning, and execution.

Requirements: 

- 1-3 years of experience in a similar technical client-facing position, OR graduate with a degree in STEM

- Experience with databases and SQL - a Must

- Outstanding technical and analytical skills

- Highly motivated with an exceptional work ethic

- High attention to detail with an ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills

- Quick, self-learning capabilities and creativity in problem-solving

- This is a hybrid role, and you will be required in our Dundee office 2 days per week

- Must be eligible to work in the UK – we are unable to provide sponsorship at this time 

Preferred: 

- Familiarity with Python

- Familiarity with Airflow, ETL tools, Snowflake and MSSQL

- Hands-on with VCS (Git)

- Genuinely curious and already reaching for AI tools to work smarter (or itching to). This matters to us more than it might elsewhere

Optimove offers a vibrant, people‑first culture where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning shape everything we do. Our UK team enjoys a modern office with a hybrid work model, daily lunch budget when onsite, and a fully stocked kitchen, along with a wide range of social events throughout the year. We’re committed to helping our people grow in an inclusive, supportive workplace recognised as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Tech and for Wellbeing.

Optimove is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants fairly, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

By submitting this application, you agree that Optimove will process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR. For details, see our Privacy Policy .

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do 

- Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

- Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

- Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

- Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

- Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

- Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

- Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

- Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

- Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

- Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have 

- Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

- Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

- Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

- Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here 

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you .

Benefits Include: 

- Competitive compensation, including equity

- Full health, dental, and vision coverage

- Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

- Flexible time off

- Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together .

Employment Information

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

At-Will Employment

title: Staff Product Manager [Machine Learning expertise]
description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here ). 

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. 

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

- Own the ML product roadmap end-to-end: Define what we build, why, and in what order — gathering insights from engineering, data science, and business teams to develop a prioritized strategy that addresses real customer needs.

- Drive key ML product initiatives: Lead the definition and design of ML solutions for products like Attachment Matcher, Transaction Categorizer — from discovery through delivery.

- Collaborate across the full stack: Work with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of ML capabilities that drive measurable business value.

- Own your decisions and communicate them clearly: Articulate the rationale behind priorities and engage key stakeholders — including customers, product, and executive teams.

- Continuously improve through data: Monitor and analyze the performance of models and products, making data-driven recommendations to raise the bar.

- A domain being reshaped by AI: ML is transforming financial services — from expense categorization to cashflow forecasting. You'll build products at the frontier of what's possible, not maintain existing ones.

- Squad autonomy as the default: You own your roadmap and ship without red tape. No approval chains, no waiting on committees.

- Real impact at scale: Your work will directly affect how 600,000+ SMEs manage their finances every day.

- Cross-functional collaboration: You'll sit at the intersection of product, data science, and engineering — with a team that values craft and moves fast.

You'll work closely with Sophie , Manager of the AI Lab. Sophie has led cross-functional teams through the full product lifecycle at both fast-growing startups and established tech companies. She partners directly with Product and Tech leadership to align the AI roadmap with Qonto's strategic goals.

title: Stage Data Analyst - Paris (H/F/X)
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises.

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure.

- 
Collecter, nettoyer, préparer les données à partir de sources diverses (bases de données internes, API, logs, etc.).

- 
Explorer et analyser les données pour identifier tendances, anomalies, corrélations, patterns utiles.

- 
Participer à la conception et réalisation de dashboards / reportings sous outils de data visualisation (ex. Tableau, PowerBI, ou outils internes) pour présenter les résultats aux équipes ou aux clients.

- 
Contribuer à la définition de KPI pertinents selon les objectifs métier.

- 
Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes métier (marketing, produit, etc.) pour bien comprendre leurs besoins et transformer ces besoins en analyses exploitables.

- 
Aider à automatiser certains processus de reporting ou analyses simples.

- 
Documenter tes travaux, partager les résultats et les apprentissages au sein de l’équipe, proposer des améliorations ou de nouvelles approches quand c’est possible.

Profil recherché 

- 
Étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en Data, Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques appliquées, Statistiques ou Informatique et recherche un stage de fin d'études à partir de Janvier 2027.

- 
Maîtrise de SQL pour extraire / manipuler les données.

- 
Connaissances en langage de programmation pour l’analyse de données, typiquement Python (avec pandas, numpy, etc.).

- 
Bonne compréhension des principes statistiques de base (moyennes, distributions, tests, corrélations, variance, etc.).

- 
Capacité à créer des visualisations / dashboards (Tableau, PowerBI, ou outil équivalent).

- 
Connaissance minimale de l’écosystème numérique et data (web analytics, datalake, dataviz, etc.) est un plus.

Compétences personnelles / soft skills : 

- 
Esprit logique et analytique, souci du détail.

- 
Sens de la communication orale et écrite : savoir expliquer ses résultats à des non-experts.

- 
Capacité à travailler en équipe, à écouter et à comprendre les besoins métier.

- 
Proactivité, curiosité, et capacité à proposer des idées ou des approches nouvelles.

- 
Autonomie, tout en étant à l’aise avec le suivi et les retours.

- 
Bon niveau en français (oral et écrit) ; l’anglais professionnel est un plus, notamment pour échanges ou documentations. 

Ce que nous offrons 

- Un stage de 6 mois basé à Paris dans le 9ème arrondissement 

- Un accompagnement par un tuteur expérimenté et l'opportunité de travailler avec des équipes reconnues 

- La possibilité d'être embauché(e) en CDI à l'issue du stage 

- Socle de formation (training day, Retex, café tech) développement des compétences via des outils internes innovants 

Prêt à rejoindre l'aventure ? 

Si tu te reconnais dans cette description et que tu souhaites mettre tes compétences au service de projets concrets et impactants, envoie-nous ta candidature !

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
description:
Help make the world more hospitable 

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role 

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. Your expertise in Python, DBT , SQL, and Databricks will drive operational efficiency, accelerate our month-end close, and deliver strategic insights that inform capital allocation and IPO readiness. This is a greenfield opportunity to own the analytics roadmap, work directly with Finance leadership, and build infrastructure that powers both scaling and compliance, all at a pivotal moment for Mews

What you would do

- Design and develop analytical features that surface actionable insights for Finance leadership

- Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL

- Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques

- Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders

- Collaborate across Finance to translate business requirements into technical implementations

- Advocate for modern data practices and continuous improvement of the stack

What you would bring

- Hands-on production experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines (minimum 3 years)

- Proficiency in SQL and Python; strong experience with DBT or equivalent modern data transformation tools

- Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly

- Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture

- Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems

- Demonstrated commitment to data quality, testing and accuracy; take pride in work that's been thoroughly validated

- AI Fluency Level 3: In this role, you'll redesign how Finance approaches data discovery and analysis using AI—not just automating your own work, but building patterns and tools that shape how the whole team questions data and validates insights. You'll use AI to accelerate model development and testing, but critically, you'll actively question what it produces and know when to push back. You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.

- For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence. 

Nice to have

- Experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI

- Background working with regulated or governed data

- Experience scaling analytics in fast-growing startups or scale-ups

Pay Transparency at Mews 

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you? 

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits 

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

- Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)

- Participation in our company share program

- Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)

- An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development

- Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself

- A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year

- Relocation options, available after one year

- Flexible, hybrid working options

- A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance

- Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits 

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews 

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

- High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.

- Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.

- We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.

- AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. 

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

- Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt. 

- Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen). 

- Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Speechify is the easiest way to listen to the world’s information. Articles on the web, documents in the cloud, books on your phone. We absorb it all and let you listen to it at your desk, on the go, at your own speed, and with tools that make learning easier, deeper, and faster.

What streaming services have done for audio entertainment, we’re doing for audio information. And whatever we’re doing seems to be working. We’re #1 in our category, and experiencing exponential growth.

Overview 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Experiences Team. This team builds and maintains the foundational services and SDKs that power Speechify’s product experience across platforms. What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Collaborate with Speechify’s Product Teams to scope projects, find ways to reduce scope to get faster feedback from customers, navigate the integration/UX tradeoffs relevant to different product teams, and deliver solutions via our cross-platform SDK

- Optimize existing functionality to ship things like faster loading and more intelligent parsing by designing more efficient abstractions and improving our algorithms

- Ship cloud functions, lightweight backend services, and jobs using Kotlin

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- Systems thinking. You know that optimizing a system requires end-to-end design, and you believe simplicity is valuable.

- Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and options and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time

- Focus. We’re a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down

- Collaboration. You know how to inspire, play, and negotiate with opinionated designers, marketers, and PMs

- Preferred Tech Stack:

- Kotlin Multiplatform (Java experience is OK but role is Kotlin Multiplatform) 

- Prior experience with GCP is a plus

What We Offer 

- A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.

- An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.

- A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.

- An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.

- Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.

- Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.

- Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.

- Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

- Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, Lucid, and LG.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. 

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. 

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. 

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. 

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. 

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

- Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability

- Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful

- Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable

- Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design

- Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network

- (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About you

- 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale

- Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history

- Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust

- Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing

- Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software

- A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks

- Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality

- Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

- Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)

- Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs

- Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)

- Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)

- Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)

- Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll? 🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source . In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits 

- Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt. 

- Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server. 

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen. 

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice . Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

- 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst. 

- Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag. 

- Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine. 

- Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken. 

- Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden. 

- Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner. 

- Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben 

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

- Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur. 

- Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen. 

- Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible. 

- Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX. 

- KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz. 

- Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux 

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker , IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. 

- Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums. 

- Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten. 

- Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur . 

- Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere. 

- Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung , beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien. 

- Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen. 

- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. 

- Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren. 

- Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil.

title: AI Senior Engineer (Graph)
description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. 

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. 

What you’ll be doing 

We are seeking someone who views the Knowledge Graph not just as a database, but as a living organism that requires constant care, feeding, and pruning. You understand that a RAG system is only as good as the data underlying it. You are intrigued by the complexity of ingesting massive, messy datasets and transforming them into clean, connected knowledge.

In short, someone who likes:

- Architecting Graph ETL: Designing and developing robust ETL pipelines specifically for graph ingestion. You aren't just dumping rows into tables; you are determining how disparate data sources connect, evolve, and relate in a graph structure.

- Data Ingestion at Scale: Managing high-volume data streams using tools like Kafka and implementing CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns to ensure the graph reflects real-time reality.

- Automated Graph Hygiene: Writing scripts and jobs for deduplication , orphan node detection , and data consistency checks. You take pride in a clean schema.

- Modeling Time: Handling complex temporal relationships (e.g., how property ownership or financial status changes over time) within the graph.

- Performance Tuning: Ensuring that as the graph grows (25k+ reports and beyond), the underlying query performance remains snappy through optimizing indexes and storage.

What we’re looking for 

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

- Neo4j Expertise (Must Have): 4+ years of hands-on experience. You master Cypher , schema design, and the operational side of managing a production graph.

- ETL & Pipeline Mastery: Strong background in building data pipelines. You know how to take raw data, clean it, and structure it for graph ingestion.

- Streaming & CDC: Familiarity with event streaming platforms like Kafka and Change Data Capture methodologies to sync operational databases with the graph.

- Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for writing ingestion scripts, maintenance jobs, and custom graph algorithms.

- Data Integrity Focus: Experience implementing automated jobs for entity resolution , deduplication, and quality assurance.

Nice-to-Have: 

- C# Knowledge: Ability to read or contribute to C# codebases.

- Domain Experience: Prior work in Finance or Real Estate sectors.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

- To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

- Payments made in USD.

- 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

- Wellness + Remote Stipend

- AI Voucher

About Able 

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

About the Company

We are a growing lighting company with locations across North America, specialising in residential and commercial lighting.

The business operates three Shopify stores covering wholesale, direct-to-consumer and luxury/heavy-trade customers, with a combined catalogue of approximately 4,000 SKUs .

The Role

We are looking for a Part-Time Shopify Developer to join the team and take ownership of the technical and development side of the Shopify stores.

You will work alongside a full-time Shopify Manager who will handle the day-to-day site operations, catalogue management and content updates. Your focus will be on development, troubleshooting, integrations and ongoing technical improvements.

This is not a from-scratch app development role . The business already has a custom product recommendation engine and several integrations in place. You will primarily be working within the existing environment — modifying, extending, troubleshooting and maintaining what is already there, as well as handling general Shopify theme and Liquid development.

Key Responsibilities

- Modify, extend and troubleshoot existing Shopify apps and integrations, including the custom product recommendation engine.

- Develop and maintain Shopify themes using Liquid and Online Store 2.0 .

- Work across three Shopify stores, implementing new functionality and technical improvements as required.

- Support the technical setup of the business's four-tier B2B pricing and catalogue structure , including price lists, customer-specific pricing and gated content.

- Troubleshoot technical issues such as theme conflicts, app conflicts, cart and checkout issues.

- Assist with Klaviyo integrations and technical setup when required.

- Work closely with the full-time Shopify Manager and Sales/Marketing teams to handle development requests and ongoing technical improvements.

- Take over development tasks currently managed by an external agency.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify Plus development .

- Excellent knowledge of Liquid, Shopify theme architecture and Online Store 2.0 .

- Experience working within and modifying an existing codebase , including debugging and extending apps or integrations built by other developers.

- Experience with Shopify B2B , including price lists, customer/company-specific pricing and login-gated catalogues or content.

- Experience working with large Shopify product catalogues.

- Familiarity with Matrixify or similar bulk import/export tools .

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Nice-to-Have Experience

- Experience with Klaviyo and Shopify/ESP integrations.

- Experience working alongside or taking over from an external Shopify development agency.

- Experience with product recommendation engines, personalisation tools or similar Shopify technology.

- Previous experience supporting multi-store Shopify environments.

Contract & Logistics

- Part-time contract role – approximately 20 hours per week. 

- Engaged through Assist World .

- You will work alongside a full-time Shopify Manager responsible for day-to-day Shopify operations.

- Must be available during PST business hours for communication and collaboration with the team.

- Compensation will be confirmed based on the client's available monthly budget.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can step into an existing Shopify environment and hit the ground running . You should be comfortable troubleshooting technical issues, working with existing code and integrations, and finding practical solutions without needing constant direction.

If you're an experienced Shopify Plus developer who enjoys working independently and taking ownership of the technical side of an established e-commerce environment, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Coop ( https://smart.coop.farm )| 2nd Founding Engineer | iOS Heavy Engineer | Hybrid onsite | Austin, TX | Full-time, Part-time My name is AJ Forsythe and I'm the Founder / Chief Chicken Tender at Coop! We're an Austin TX based company on a mission to build the world’s largest decentralized food production network, starting with AI powered chicken Coops. We’ve been in the market for about 18 months and our customers are in 48 states and will generate about >10M eggs this year. It's insanely fun to work on and we have a shot at building a huge business in the connected urban farming space. If you’re big into computer vision, consumer products that are fun, and an awesome team we would love to chat. The Coop has an automatic door + cameras doing computer vision work (predator detection, egg alerts, remote health monitoring, etc). It's a super exciting time and are seeing directional product market fit which I'm thrilled about. Seriously go check out our website, it's a super fun + amazing product. We’re a tight-knit team of 5 people with 15+ years of experience working together. We’ve been through YC, started and scaled multinational million-dollar businesses together, taking them from idea to acquisition by a Fortune 50 company. We’re gritty and passionate without taking ourselves too seriously - and we’re here to build something really exciting that helps people reconnect with their food and the planet. We're VC backed (call it $5M) by some of the world's best investors but we are a scrappy small team that moves fast.
We have an absolutely fantastic CTO Ryan that I'm looking for his / our right hand person to work alongside with. I think the term full stack is overused but that's closest to what we're looking for. Also this really isn’t a traditional Eng role, I look at it as we’re a small growing team and you would be one of us working on a ton a cool projects on day 1. Also, we LOVE working with founders so if you've started a company before that's epic. Oh also, I have a fun project where I want to make a water gun turret that uses our cameras to detect predators and allows you to aim and blast them. If you're into hacking robotics and gimbals etc, please reach out. You can also reach out to me directly at: aj[at]coop.farm - Just email me your LinkedIn / GitHub / portfolio + why you think you'll be an awesome fit and I'll respond. Please don’t use GPT too much. This is my 3rd company (2 have exited) and I want to build the super solid core team and you might be the perfect fit for us and vice versa.
Bwok Bwok! AJ

title: Controls Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy 

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Join us as a Control Systems Engineer and help to provide the clean energy of the future. In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of critical control systems across our experimental and production environments in Germany and the USA, and work closely with a passionate, cross‑functional team.

About the Role 

You will report to the Controls Engineering Lead and join a small, collaborative team of 3–5 engineers. The role is hybrid, with the expectation of occasional travel to our Austin, TX site. Working hours follow standard business schedules, and on-call needs are minimal and largely confined to regular working hours.

What You’ll Do 

- Lead the design and development of PLC-based control subsystems, supporting cutting-edge laser fusion technologies, and work in collaboration with scientists and engineers to gather requirements and iterate solutions.

- Own the integration and control systems for critical experiment support infrastructure such as vacuum, pneumatics, and cooling plant.

- Develop control software for modern PLCs such as Beckhoff TwinCAT in Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) for machine safety and process control systems.

- Commission complex experimental equipment together with scientists and engineers, including field debugging and systematic fault-finding of cutting-edge technology.

- Specify and implement SCADA systems and HMIs, including alarms, logging, data acquisition, and database integration.

- Contribute to team standards and solution architecture, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews and guidance.

Who You Are 

- Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Control/Automation, Mechatronics/Robotics, Physics or similar, with a focus on PLC-based control, embedded or real‑time systems.

- 5+ years in plant control systems, factory automation, embedded software, or complex scientific experimental work with significant PLC-based elements.

- Proficient in PLC programming in Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) following good software engineering practice, including modularization, version control (e.g. Git), and unit testing.

- Knowledge of SCADA systems (e.g. Ignition, EPICS, Tango, WinCC, FactoryTalk, AVEVA) and hands-on experience of delivering HMIs to stakeholders, including alarm and error handling, status and data visualization.

- Proficient in reading electrical wiring diagrams and P&IDs, collaborating with electrical and mechanical engineering teams to deliver physical systems.

- Familiarity with industrial networking and fieldbus protocols such as EtherCAT, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP.

- Familiarity with risk assessment processes and relevant safety standards (e.g. ISA 84, IEC 61508).

- Clear communicator in English, comfortable working in hybrid and international cross-site teams, self-organized and proactive, comfortable leading technical discussions and decisions.

- Practical, hands-on approach with proven experience in hardware/software integration, and a strong track record in debugging and fault-finding on real systems.

Desirable Skills and Knowledge (be sure to highlight any of the following in your application):

- Beckhoff PLCs and TwinCAT.

- DDS (Data Distribution Service) protocol, related tools and utilities.

- OPC UA protocol, related tools and utilities.

- Design of vacuum control systems.

- Designing control cabinet hardware to EU standards (IEC 60204 -1).

- Safety-critical systems design: safety relays, SIL determination, LOPA, risk assessment.

- Proficiency in at least one higher-level language (LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB/Simulink, C/C++).

- Higher LabVIEW qualifications (CLD, CLED, CLA) and NI hardware experience (PXIe, cRIO).

- Other non-PLC embedded or real-time systems (FPGAs, RTOS, microcontrollers, robotics).

- Experience working on complex scientific equipment or large-scale research facilities.

- Image processing and machine vision, motion control and robotics.

Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Kepler | Full Stack Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | $230K-$260K + equity
description:
Kepler | Full Stack Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | $230K-$260K + equity
We're building the trust layer for AI in high-stakes industries. https://kepler.ai LLMs hallucinate, so they can't be the thing producing your numbers. In Kepler, the LLM orchestrates (decides what data to gather, what to compute, how to structure the output), but the model never touches the data itself. Every actual value flows through deterministic code pipelines with provenance metadata back to source. Verification loops cross-check outputs before users see them. We started in finance because tolerance for wrong answers is zero. First product is a research platform for buy-side analysts: pull comparables, build models, research filings. Same architecture extends to chemicals, legal, healthcare. Models are commoditizing fast; the trust layer is what's missing. If you want the deeper architecture writeup, Anthropic just published a case study on Kepler: https://claude.com/blog/how-kepler-built-verifiable-ai-for-f... What you'd build: - Source-explorer UI that traces any value back to its exact origin in the original document - Extraction pipeline for a data source we don't yet handle, with provenance and verification from day one - Agent orchestrator that handles partial failures so a bad extraction from one source doesn't block parallel work - Verification rules that cross-check values across multiple sources and surface conflicts with provenance on both sides Stack: Rust backend (orchestration, extraction, computation), TypeScript/React frontend, PostgreSQL, AWS. Model-agnostic, currently Claude + GPT. We don't require Rust experience; we hire on fundamentals. Looking for 5 years production experience, strong in TypeScript/React, comfortable in backend work. Bonus if you've built systems where correctness mattered (payments, data infra, healthcare, anything where a wrong output has consequences). Distributed systems basics: concurrency, fault tolerance, retries, idempotency. Founding team is 40+ combined years at Palantir building Foundry's core systems (Ontology, Fusion, Workshop, FoundryML). CEO scaled a data company to $15M ARR, sold it, then ran Business Engineering at Citadel. Backed by founders of OpenAI, Meta AI Research, MotherDuck, dbt Labs. In-office NYC. Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/kepler-ai/52624a4e-33e3-4f16-8028-0... , or email me: eddie.hammond@kepler.ai

description: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN Since July we're an independent lab inside SAP, with more than EUR 1B committed over four years. title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

AI and agentic engineering

Team, resourcing, and accountability

Platform and execution

- Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. In the first year, expect to:

- Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.

- Hands-on experience with Debezium or comparable CDC tooling, particularly in production deployments, is a strong bonus.
